feature_definitions.StockMom60_raw: Identical frozen residual raw_return-beta*TOPIX; shift1 per observed Code/relisting segment; rolling60 sum min60; gap>20 ordinal reset.

feature_definitions.missing: Unknown 99/9999, missing/blank classifications excluded; nonfinite stock excluded. Insufficient finite group remains NaN. Context unavailable preserves BASELINE.
feature_definitions.HIER_SECTOR_MOM: finite33 first, else finite17, else unavailable; no blend.
feature_definitions.A: BASELINE final score<0 and finite SECTOR33_MOM>0 -> exact0, otherwise BASELINE.
feature_definitions.B: BASELINE final score<0 and finite HIER_SECTOR_MOM>0 -> exact0, otherwise BASELINE.
feature_definitions.final_ranking: No candidate rerank, smoothing, fit or overlay. Official global quintile ranking follows final score; Code tie ordering identical baseline. Final zero scores can remain Short under global ranking.

selection_rule: B requires ALL specified adoption checks vs BASELINE; apply economic gates on POOLED, EX2016 NetSR and 4/5 full-year improvements mandatory. Paired pooled bootstrap lower>0. Q not materially worse = pooled Spearman decrease <=0.1 and Q5-Q1>0. DeltaShortNet>0 and DeltaShortGross/DeltaShortNet>=0.5. A evaluated with same gates for comparison. Failure REJECT, all pass TRAIN_ONLY_NEXT_STAGE_ELIGIBLE, no deployment. No rescue.
